name: Opatovec → Mohelnice

A.note: Opatovec: western end of mapped proposed D35, at the temporary service-road continuation

B.note: Mohelnice: 33.3 km along the mapped proposed D35, where it starts to merge with the existing I/35 (59 m away); the last 0.6 km of the mapped line rebuilds the existing road, which the game cannot model yet

junction.about: I/35 carriageway ways within the merge zone of B. The merge onto I/35 is priced as one junction; the onward reconstruction of I/35 into D35 is outside this exercise.

hard.name: Greywacke / conglomerate / quartzite — uncalibrated regional prior

baselineNote: Road exercise in the full Opatovec–Mohelnice corridor, not a motorway traffic forecast. The route ends 33.3 km along the 33.9 km OSM proposed line, where it starts merging with the existing I/35; the merge is priced as one junction, and the rest, a rebuild of the existing road, is not modelled. The official combined projects total 34.830 km including existing-road reconstruction. Ground profiles are uncalibrated regional priors, not the D11 fit.
